description: This file contains asynchronous test functions for the /health and related endpoints of a web service, utilizing pytest and aiohttp to verify health status, health/readiness/liveliness endpoints, and route availability.

methods.name: health(session, call_key)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the /health endpoint with authorization headers.

methods.name: generate_key(session)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to generate a new API key with specified models.

methods.name: test_health()
methods.description: Tests the /health endpoint by asserting the total count of healthy and unhealthy models.

methods.name: test_health_readiness()
methods.description: Tests the /health/readiness endpoint, verifying presence of specific keys in the JSON response.

methods.name: test_health_liveliness()
methods.description: Tests the /health/liveliness endpoint, ensuring it returns a 200 status.

methods.name: test_routes()
methods.description: Tests the /routes endpoint for a successful 200 response.
